title: Mobile Wallet Cancellation Rights
content:
Cancellation disclosure for **Mobile Wallet** transfers under the Remittance Transfer Rule.

**Who cancels.** Only the customer can cancel their own transfer; the agent explains what will be refunded and the customer confirms.

**When a transfer can be cancelled.** A Mobile Wallet transfer can be cancelled only before it is released, while its status is awaiting funds or on hold. Once a credit has been sent it cannot be cancelled, and a failed credit is refunded under the Mobile Wallet refund rules instead.

**Fees inside the full-refund window.** A fee is refunded in full on cancellation only when the customer confirms the cancellation within the tier's full-refund window, in elapsed hours after the transfer was booked. The window is measured in elapsed hours from the booking moment to the cancellation moment recorded on the transfer, and a cancellation at exactly the end of the window is inside it. Inside the window every fee collected is refunded, with the fee-refund reason "cancellation in window".

**Fees after the window.** After the window each booking fee collected is refunded at the tier's late-cancellation share of its amount, rounded half up to the cent, with the fee-refund reason "cancellation post window".

**Principal.** The principal is always refunded in full under the Mobile Wallet refund rules.

**Once only.** Each fee charge is refunded at most once; a fee charge that already has a refund recorded against it is not refunded again.

### Boundary and worked cases (hypothetical)

| Booked | Cancelled | Inside the 0.50-hour window | Fees refunded |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10:00:00 | 10:30:00 | yes, exactly at the end | every fee in full |
| 10:00:00 | 10:30:01 | no | each booking fee at the tier's late-cancellation share |

*Hypothetical:* a Mobile Wallet Express Plus transfer with a transfer fee of 3.49, cancelled after the window while awaiting funds: the late-cancellation share on that tier is 50 percent, so 3.49 multiplied by 0.50 is 1.745, rounded half up to 1.75; the principal is refunded in full.
